backend/main.mo: Motoko backend storing inquiries in memory and exposing submit and query endpoints with basic validation.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping multiple UI/branding features to affected frontend files and components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing purpose and design details of various frontend files.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base stylesheet defining color tokens, themes, and global background/foreground variables.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry file loading fonts and mounting the React application.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up TanStack Router and defines all main application routes using a shared layout.
frontend/src/components/CategoryHierarch: Accordion component listing subcategories and product types with styled hierarchy and markers.
frontend/src/components/SiteFooter.tsx: Footer with company info, navigation links, contact details, and attribution block.
frontend/src/components/SiteHeader.tsx: Responsive header with logo, navigation, active-state indicator, and mobile menu support.
frontend/src/components/SiteLayout.tsx: Layout wrapper combining header, footer, and routed page content.
Empty file placeholder with no implemented content.
frontend/src/data/productTaxonomy.ts: Defines product category, subcategory, and type interfaces and exports a large taxonomy of equestrian products.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to the user's Internet Identity, refreshing dependent queries when the identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides React context and hooks for managing Internet Identity authentication, including login, logout, and identity persistence.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines a mutation hook that submits inquiry data through the backend actor and invalidates related queries on success.
frontend/src/index.css: Configures Tailwind base styles and custom theme variables for a navy‑gold design system with typography and component styles.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider and loads global CSS.
frontend/src/pages/AboutPage.tsx: Renders the About Us page with company background, mission, and differentiators using styled content sections.
frontend/src/pages/CataloguePage.tsx: Displays a catalogue request page outlining features and linking users to a contact form for catalogue requests.
frontend/src/pages/CategoryPage.tsx: Displays a category detail page with banner, subcategories, and inquiry navigation; handles missing categories gracefully.
frontend/src/pages/ContactPage.tsx: Implements an inquiry form with validation, optional prefilled category, submission handling, and a success state view.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Renders the homepage with a hero section, company introduction, highlights, and navigation CTAs to products and catalogue.
frontend/src/pages/ProductsPage.tsx: Shows a grid of product categories with images and links to their respective category pages.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind theme extensions, custom colors, typography, shadows, and plugins for styling.
project_state.json: Defines project metadata, design guidelines, taxonomy rules, image requirements, and existing implemented features.
